items.label: MAGNETIC BALLS & STICKS
items.value: This STEM learning toy is an open-ended magnetic construction toy for all age children. They will love this magnet block with endless variations. Let your kids’ imagination run wild and create their own works!

items.label: DEVELOP CREATIVITY & CONFIDENCE
items.value: The colorful magnetic blocks helps your children to recognize basic colors and shapes, promote their creativity, symbolic thinking, and problem solving ability while they have fun.

items.label: SPECIAL DESIGN & EASY TO PLAY
items.value: Come with 25 magnetic sticks in a variety of shapes provide kids endless possibility to create different models. They can build many 2D and 3D models according their own imagination.

items.label: NON-TOXIC & HIGH QUALITY
items.value: Made of high quality ABS plastic and permanent magnets, easy to connect and disconnect. The smooth surface will not hurt your baby’s delicate skin. It is a durable use construction toy.

items.label: ENJOY YOUR FAMILY TIME
items.value: Suitable for girls, boys, and toddlers, it is a perfect choice for parent-child interaction, kids will willing to complete their work under your help. It’s also a great classroom educational toy for teacher in school or kindergarten.

items.label: Educational Objective
items.value: Construction Skills,STEM,Imagination Development,Creative Thinking,Problem Solving Skills,Motor Skills,Intellectual Curiosity,Cognitive Flexibility
